snippet.title: Realindustry – Official Demo Trailer | Industrial Evaluation Build
snippet.description:
Director, your evaluation period begins now. Experience the first 5 Tech Tiers of the most authentic industrial simulation ever created.

Play the FREE Demo on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4525260/Realindustry_Demo

In the Realindustry Demo, every process follows real-world industrial logic. You are appointed as the Director of NIZ-08 on Kepler-442b. Your objective: build, optimize, and expand using real materials and scientific data.

Demo Key Features:
– 102 Real Materials. Authentically modeled resources with chemical formulas.
– 148 Production Processes. From basic metallurgy to advanced chemistry.
– 30 Industrial Facilities. Each with unique, high-fidelity acoustic environments.
– 59 Research Technologies. A deep web of dependencies from the Stone Age to Tech Tier 5.

Do not deviate. Do not question. Produce.

Wishlist full game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4384850/Realindustry/
Join the Sector 08 Discord: https://discord.gg/QwnaZxSBc6
Official Website: https://realindustrygame.com/
Follow us on X: https://x.com/RealindustryDev
Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@realindustry_game
